title: Here’s How to Watch ‘The Chosen’ Season 6 Online for Free

After five seasons and seven years, the faith-based TV series The Chosen is coming to an end with season six, which drops this weekend.

Watch on Prime Video

How to Watch ‘The Chosen’ Season 6 Online, at a Glance:

- Date: Starting on Nov. 15

- No. of Episodes: 6

- Online Streaming: Prime Video

When Does ‘The Chosen’ Season 6 Start ?

The TV series The Chosen is released on Sunday (Nov. 15) with a three-episode season premiere. New episodes drop every Sunday until the sixth episode on Dec. 6. The finale then comes out in theaters on Friday (Mar. 12, 2027).

What TV Network Features ‘The Chosen’ Season 6?

In 2026, The Chosen season six streams exclusively on Prime Video . However, the TV series isn’t available to watch on any broadcast or cable network.

Where to Watch ‘The Chosen’ Online for Free

For cord-cutters, the best way to watch The Chosen online is with a subscription to Prime Video . Luckily, the streaming service comes with a free trial, so you can watch for free.

Created by Dallas Jenkins, The Chosen follows the ministry of Jesus of Nazareth, while season 6 explores the final 24 hours of His life from the Garden of Gethsemane to His crucifixtion. The TV series stars Shahar Isaac, Jonathan Roumie, Elizabeth Tabish, Paras Patel, Noah James, George H. Xanthis and others.

And for the final season, Boyz II Men and Lady A have teamed up for the song “I Love the One.”

Starting on Sunday (Nov. 15), the first three episodes of The Chosen season six drops on Prime Video .

Want to catch up before watching season six? The first five seasons are available to stream for $24.95 on Prime Video . In the meantime, The Chosen is also streamable on watch.thechosen.tv.
